authorization: Owner authorized the census on 2026-11-01 (owner's answer, verbatim: "Sí, ahora (Recommended)").
operator: agent, on the owner's machine under the owner's authorization; the owner reviews this record
window: 28 x 24 hours before the scan on 2026-11-01 (from the evening of 2026-10-04), by file modification time

sources.claude-session: Claude Code transcripts of all local projects, a session and its subagent transcripts counted once
sources.run-directory: directories under the Agent Braid home with JSON files in the window

detection: An artifact counts only when it appears in the result of a tool that runs Agent Braid (agent-braid or m4_alpha MCP tools, Workflow, or a shell command invoking the agent_braid CLI) or, for gate results, in a workflow completion notification; kinds are recognised by contract identifiers and required keys. Results of file reads and other shell commands are excluded, so source and fixture reading during development is not counted.

synthetic.description: throwaway fixture and probe corpora created for SPEC-052 gate runs, hardening and host verification

nonSynthetic.description: owner sessions outside those corpora: 6 in Agent Braid development worktrees, 5 elsewhere (Codex workspaces, another repository, a temporary directory)

threshold.rule: at least 5 sessions or run directories with at least one coordination artifact, and at least 3 of the 6 kinds overall (OD-8)

notes: No grant was observed in any session; grants appear only in fixtures and tests.
No Codex session and no Agent Braid home run directory contained a coordination artifact.
limits: Counts and kinds only: no content, paths, session identifiers or project names were recorded.
Most non-synthetic sessions are development of Agent Braid itself, so the population exercising the tools is the project's own work, not independent adoption.

Detection is heuristic: results of shell commands that ran the CLI indirectly, or tool outputs truncated by the host, can be missed; the first scanner pass missed gate notifications and m4_alpha tools and was corrected before this record.
File modification time approximates activity; a session touched in the window but started earlier counts.
The census script is a throwaway (sha256 613a95c844703580c2968fa8ed971fc1ae59774ec1c8ffefd2a5da131d566f5d), not committed; the hash identifies the bytes used only and is not repository-verifiable.
unitDefinition: a unit is one session (with its subagent transcripts) or one run directory; per-kind counts are units containing at least one artifact of that kind, so kinds can overlap and do not sum to the unit count
